setup.title: Launch the CloudLab experiment (1 name server + 2 load generators)
commands: python3 cloudlab_api/launch.py launch --name dns-d710 --num-testers 2 --server-software bind --server-hw d710 --tester-hw d710
python3 cloudlab_api/launch.py status <experiment_id>   # node ssh commands

setup.title: On test_host_0: create an SSH key and authorize it on every node
commands: cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub   # append this line to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on NS_Local and test_host_1

setup.title: On test_host_0: generate the zone and load it on the name server
On every load generator: receive replies on one RX queue (kxdpgun in generic mode reads queue 0 only)
Point the search config at this machine

optimize.title: Host changes (run as root on NS_Local)
commands:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/dnswait.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
exec >/var/tmp/dnswait.log 2>&1
set -x
boot=$(( $(date +%s) - $(cut -d. -f1 /proc/uptime) ))
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  s=$(stat -c %Y /var/tmp/startup-5.status 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  [ "$s" -gt "$boot" ] && break
  sleep 5
done
sleep 5
cp -a /var/local/bindbak/. /etc/bind/
ethtool -G eno4 rx 2040; sleep 5
for q in /sys/class/net/eno4/queues/rx-*; do echo ff > $q/rps_cpus; done
sysctl -w net.core.netdev_max_backlog=30000 net.core.rmem_max=16777216 net.core.rmem_default=16777216
ethtool -C eno4 rx-usecs 200 rx-frames 128 rx-usecs-irq 200 rx-frames-irq 128
ethtool -K eno4 gro off
for i in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do printf '%x' $((1<<i)) > /sys/class/net/eno4/queues/tx-$i/xps_cpus; done
sysctl -w net.core.default_qdisc=pfifo_fast
tc qdisc replace dev eno4 root handle 1: mq
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=0 net.ipv4.conf.eno4.rp_filter=0 net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter=0
echo always > /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled
tc qdisc show dev eno4; ethtool -c eno4; cat /proc/cmdline; wc -l /etc/bind/db.workbench.lan
exit 0
EOF
